writeup: The WOW Zig Zag steerable towable tube (MFG 12-1050, also sold as SKU 324490) is a 60-by-54-inch Flex-Wing for one or two riders with a 340-pound capacity. Woot has this new tube at $49.99, with 10 or more left and a 10-per-customer limit. Overton's, Camping World, and Boatplicity all currently sell the same 12-1050 in stock for $119.99, which puts this about 58 percent and $70 below the live street price. Explosive Powersports has it at $129.59 and Kohl's at $139.98.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B007CISI3E as an exact match to the WOW Zig Zag steerable towable tube (MFG 12-1050); Woot condition field was null (treated as new).
